product.name: Stoneware Mug Terra
facts: Matte terracotta glaze outside, glossy inside

copies.title: Terra Stoneware Mug, 350 ml, Handmade in Portugal
copies.short_description: A handmade stoneware mug with a matte terracotta outside and a smooth glossy inside, sized for a proper cup of coffee or tea.
copies.description_html:
Your morning coffee deserves a mug that feels good in the hand. Terra is shaped by hand in Portugal, so every piece has its own small character.

  • 350 ml: room for a full mug of coffee, tea or hot chocolate
  • Matte terracotta glaze outside for a warm, earthy look
  • Glossy glaze inside that rinses clean easily
  • Dishwasher and microwave safe for everyday use

Pairs well with the rest of the Casa Lume kitchen range.
copies.seo_title: Handmade Stoneware Mug 350 ml | Terra by Casa Lume
copies.meta_description: Terra stoneware mug, handmade in Portugal. 350 ml, matte terracotta glaze, glossy inside. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

copies.title: Steingut-Tasse Terra, 350 ml, handgemacht in Portugal
copies.short_description: Handgefertigte Steingut-Tasse mit matter Terrakotta-Glasur außen und glänzender Innenseite, ideal für Kaffee und Tee.
copies.description_html:
Ein Becher, der gut in der Hand liegt: Terra wird in Portugal von Hand geformt, deshalb ist jedes Stück ein kleines Unikat.

  • 350 ml Fassungsvermögen für Kaffee, Tee oder Kakao
  • Matte Terrakotta-Glasur außen
  • Glänzende Glasur innen, leicht zu reinigen
  • Spülmaschinen- und mikrowellengeeignet
copies.meta_description: Handgemachte Steingut-Tasse aus Portugal, 350 ml, matte Terrakotta-Glasur, spülmaschinen- und mikrowellengeeignet.

copies.title: Mug en grès Terra, 350 ml, fait main au Portugal
copies.short_description: Un mug en grès façonné à la main, émail terracotta mat à l'extérieur et brillant à l'intérieur.
copies.description_html:
Façonné à la main au Portugal, Terra rend chaque café un peu plus agréable.

  • 350 ml pour le café, le thé ou le chocolat chaud
  • Émail terracotta mat à l'extérieur
  • Intérieur brillant, facile à rincer
  • Compatible lave-vaisselle et micro-ondes
copies.seo_title: Mug en grès fait main 350 ml | Terra
copies.meta_description: Mug en grès fait main au Portugal, 350 ml, émail terracotta mat, compatible lave-vaisselle et micro-ondes.

copies.title: Stoneware mok Terra, 350 ml, handgemaakt in Portugal
copies.short_description: Handgemaakte stoneware mok met matte terracotta buitenkant en glanzende binnenkant.
copies.description_html:
Een mok die fijn in je hand ligt. Terra wordt met de hand gemaakt in Portugal, dus elke mok is net even anders.

  • 350 ml voor koffie, thee of warme chocolademelk
  • Matte terracotta glazuur aan de buitenkant
  • Glanzende binnenkant, makkelijk schoon te spoelen
  • Vaatwasser- en magnetronbestendig
copies.meta_description: Handgemaakte stoneware mok uit Portugal, 350 ml, matte terracotta glazuur, vaatwasser- en magnetronbestendig.

review_notes: 'Handmade' is used as given; confirm it is accurate for the whole batch.

product.name: Soy Candle Fig & Cedar
product.original_description: Scented candle fig cedar 200g. Great gift!!!

copies.title: Fig & Cedar Soy Candle, 200 g Glass Jar
copies.short_description: A soy wax candle with a cotton wick and a fig and cedar scent, burning for about 40 hours.
copies.description_html:
Fig and cedar bring a soft, woody warmth to a room on quiet evenings. The candle is poured in soy wax with a cotton wick and comes in a reusable glass jar.

  • 200 g of soy wax
  • Burn time approx. 40 hours
  • Cotton wick

For an even burn, let the top melt to the edge the first time you light it.
copies.seo_title: Fig & Cedar Soy Candle 200 g | Casa Lume
copies.meta_description: Soy wax candle with fig and cedar scent, cotton wick and approx. 40 hours burn time, in a 200 g glass jar.
